summary: SPACE MAT is a prototype screening that helps to examine construction materials for lunar and martian mission. This system combines esp32 and sensors with a website that has a dashboard, where users can also enter readings manually when the hardware is not available. The dashboard records force, strain,displacement,temperature, and surface distance.Ai analyses readungs and nasa technical references to recommand next relevant measurements, appropriate equipments, suitable testing facilities and the limitations for that test. recommendations are collected from vetted catalogs, so equipments details are constrained rather than freely inveted.the results help the users to plan for follow up work, they do not predict whether a material will survive or certify mission readiness.SPACE MAT is intended to organise preliminaly evidence , make measurements gaps visible, and guide further investigations. its scope is earth based screening, specialised tests such as vaccum, pressure, radiations evaluation requireappropriate external laboratory equipement and trained proffesional.
details: SPACE MAT is a prototype web for early screening of material for lunar and martian missions. the user enters material reading manually and the dashboard organizes the results such as force or strain or displacement, temperature and miosture. then the ai analyses anlyses the readings and recommend a measuremtn to do next, the equipment and qualified facility needed and the text limitations. nasa technical reference provide research context not certification.this prototype is built with react,typescript and gemini. esp32 sensor intergartion is planned but has not been validated with hardaware. the project empasizes evidence, measurements uncertainity, safe testing and laboratory verifications rather than predicting whether material will survuve in space.
